tasks.title: Frame size
tasks.statement: A MAVLink 2 message with a payload of **{n}** bytes after zero truncation, frame: **{s}**. How many bytes go out on the link?
tasks.solution: 10 header bytes + payload + 2 CRC bytes (+13 signature bytes).

tasks.title: Losses from seq
tasks.statement: The previous frame from the vehicle had seq = **{a}**, the next received one has seq = **{b}**. How many frames were lost?
tasks.solution: (seq_new − seq_old − 1) mod 256 — accounting for the wrap past 255.

tasks.title: Stream budget
tasks.statement: ATTITUDE (payload 28 bytes) at **{f} Hz** and GLOBAL_POSITION_INT (payload 28 bytes) at **{g} Hz**, MAVLink 2 unsigned. What is the load on the link (bytes/s)?
tasks.solution: Frame = payload + 12 overhead bytes; multiply by the total rate.
